<!--BACKPORT [{"author":{"name":"Cristina Amico","email":"criamico@users.noreply.github.com"},"sourceCommit":{"committedDate":"2026-09-24T13:33:55Z","message":"[Fleet] Fix agentless query to exclude cross space reads (#293142)

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/291344

## Summary
Fixed a bug where agentless agents enrolled in other Kibana spaces would
appear in the Fleet agents list even when `showAgentless=false`.
Switch the agentless-policy lookup to use
`getInternalUserSOClientWithoutSpaceExtension() `with spaceId: '*'. This
ensures all agentless policies across all spaces are included in the
exclusion filter regardless of which space the caller is in.

Two additional changes accompany the client swap:

- perPage raised from 1000 → `SO_SEARCH_LIMIT` — querying across all
spaces increases the policy count; silent truncation at 1000 would
silently reintroduce the leak.
- `fields: ['supports_agentless'] `added — only IDs are needed;
returning full policy documents over the wire is unnecessary.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create Kibana spaces a and b.
- In space a, create a managed integration (agentless policy + agent).
- Navigate to Fleet → Agents in space b with showAgentless=false
(default).
- Observe that the agentless agent from space a appears in the agents
list.
- Click the agent's policy link — observe "Saved object
[fleet-agent-policies/<id>] not found".
